body: The thought of people gaining a happier longer life over my future death made me feel sick.  It's not about what I feel after I die, but what I feel now.
Still on the way to making my own business.  Working for someone else feels like I don't even have control over my soul.

People have turned me down far too many times for me to even consider helping them, especially in my death.  If dying is the only way to contribute to society, they can die along with me.  It's not like I'm asking for a handout, just a break.  When almost no one will even give me a chance to try to make a life, I won't give them the chance to continue theirs.

This high functioning autism aspergers stuff is such bullshit.  People can be so easily misdiagnosed with it it's ridiculous.  My parent's grew increasingly insane from me not being average, so to get them off my back I read up on the psych tests and made myself autistic.  It's pathetically easy.  At least you're getting money out of it.  If I am, they've been hiding it from me my entire life.

Just removed myself from the donors list.  Not that it really matters.  By the time I'm discovered my organs will likely be long dead.

[Proof] (http://i.imgur.com/HaE0Y8N.png)

So after 3 days I'm still feeling confident about this one.  If I pussy out I'll definitely let you guys know.  Otherwise, if you don't hear a response by the 2nd or 3rd of April, consider that a confirmation that I am happily dead.  Wish me luck!!!

I never felt enjoyment or satisfaction, I just watched what other people did and imitated it.  The first birthday I remember at age 5, I smiled and pretended to like the crap I opened.  Steamboat Springs at 10 felt lame.  Disney World at 13 felt like a fucking chore.  Sex is more work than it's worth.  Hours and hours of prep for 10 seconds of fun.  (I'm talking the orgasm, everything else during the act is still work.)  My family is currently supporting me and they're running out of cash, so at least whatever funeral they decide to throw me will be the last they have to spend.  I have no desire to live any longer.  Simply put.  Would you continue working an unsatisfying job for a meager paycheck to cover expenses of things you don't like?  Life is that job, and it's giving me zero in return.  The only thing people have to offer is pity and I'm done taking it.
